links.outcome: AI AUC versus human reader AUC on the same mammograms at breast and lesion level
links.effect: AI AUC 0.942 (breast) and 0.929 (lesion) versus mean human AUC 0.878 and 0.851; AI outperformed humans at both levels (ps < 0.01).
links.quote: AI outperformed human readers at the breast and lesion level (ps < 0.01, respectively) according to the AUC.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating imaging AI at lesion level (localisation) in addition to breast-level analysis

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy (breast-level vs. lesion-level localization) of a commercial mammography AI against human readers from an external quality assurance program, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
